title: Expose reusable update and delete commands
description: Complete wtp reusable with update NAME_OR_ID and delete NAME_OR_ID. Update accepts optional --name, --title, and --instructions, requires at least one supplied field, distinguishes omission from an explicit empty invalid value, and returns the updated definition. Delete performs the provider atomic detach operation and returns {deleted:...,detachedTaskCount:N} in JSON plus a precise human summary. Cover name and UUID selectors, casing-only rename, referenced and unreferenced deletion, completed-task detachment, concurrent/stale provider errors, extra arguments, and no-op updates in CLI tests. Do not add confirmation prompts or force flags; deletion semantics are deliberately detach-everywhere.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Audited the exact task and current branch: reusable create/list/show plus provider-level update/delete and atomic journal machinery already exist, while CLI mutation subcommands and requested edge-case coverage remain incomplete. I will preserve all unrelated worktree edits, add only the reusable CLI mutation surface/tests needed here, then run focused and full verification.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented reusable update/delete CLI commands. Update accepts NAME_OR_ID plus optional --name/--title/--instructions, preserves omitted fields, rejects explicit empty values, returns the updated definition, and supports casing-only and normalized no-op edits. Delete accepts NAME_OR_ID with no confirmation/force, delegates atomic detach-everywhere, emits {deleted,detachedTaskCount} JSON, and reports the exact human count with singular/plural wording. Added CLI coverage for name/UUID selectors, referenced/unreferenced and completed-task detachment, extra args, no-op updates, and concurrent/stale provider error propagation.
